title: agent_hub.warning
description: Something worth attention, with machine-readable details. code plaintext_secret: a literal value in a hub server spec looks like a credential (the value itself is never printed); the same field is also an agent_hub.conflict, so the run refuses. code machine_override_unused: the machine override file names a server the hub does not define, so that override changes nothing; the run continues.

run_id.description: Identifies one invocation; every line it emits carries it.

message.description: The same content as human prose; --human prints only this.

field.description: command, args[i], env.<KEY>, url or headers.<Name>; for machine_override_unused, mcp.<server> in the machine override file

source.description: The hub mcp.json that holds the field.
